knowledge:
- key_parameters: dataset=A SummarizedExperiment object containing the expression matrix, with gene names in rowData and condition, time, and replicate in colData ;; myanalyzeConditions=A character vector of length 2 specifying the conditions to compare (e.g., wild-type and mutant) ;; cores=Number of cores to use for parallel processing (set to 1 on Windows) ;; mytimes=A sorted numeric vector of unique measurement time points ;; experimentStepDetection=The baseline condition (typically wild-type) used to detect expression switches over time
- alternatives: None mentioned. The package internally calls NBPSeq for fold change analysis.
- when_to_use: Use when you have time-course RNA-seq data for two conditions and want to identify when genes switch their expression levels and how that correlates with differential expression between the conditions.
- pitfalls: Ensure the input SummarizedExperiment has 'condition', 'time', and 'replicate' columns in colData, and gene names in rowData. Filter out low-expression genes using a threshold before analysis to avoid noise. Set cores to 1 on Windows systems to avoid parallelization errors. When plotting with plotSSGS, exclude the last time point from the times vector.

workflows.name: time_resolved_rnaseq_analysis
workflows.intent: Compare RNA-seq time curves between two conditions to identify differential expression and expression switches over time.
input: SummarizedExperiment (containing a numeric matrix of expression values, rowData with gene names, and colData with condition, time, and replicate information)
workflows.stages: 1. Load and filter data ;; 2. Perform fold change analysis at each time point ;; 3. Detect expression switches over time ;; 4. Combine fold change and switch results ;; 5. Visualize stage-specific gene sets ;; 6. Export results to text files
workflows.code:
library(RNAsense)
data("MZsox") # load MZsox.RData in variable mydata
print(MZsox)
mydata <- MZsox
analyzeConditions <- c("WT", "MZsox")
thCount <- 100
nrcores <- 1
library(SummarizedExperiment)
#if(Sys.info()[[1]]=="Windows"){nrcores <- 1} # use parallelization only on Linux and Mac
mydata <- mydata[seq(1,nrow(mydata), by=4),]
vec2Keep <- which(vapply(1:dim(mydata)[1],function(i)
  !Reduce("&",assays(mydata)[[1]][i,]<thCount), c(TRUE)))
mydata <- mydata[vec2Keep,] # threshold is applied
times <- unique(sort(as.numeric(colData(mydata)$time))) # get measurement times from input data
resultFC <- getFC(dataset = mydata, 
                  myanalyzeConditions = analyzeConditions, 
                  cores = nrcores, 
                  mytimes = times)
head(resultFC)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(subset(resultFC, FCdetect!="none"), 
       aes(x=logFoldChange, y=-log10(pValue), color=FCdetect)) + 
       xlab("log2(Fold Change)") + geom_point(shape=20)
resultSwitch <- getSwitch(dataset = mydata,
                          experimentStepDetection = "WT",
                          cores = nrcores,
                          mytimes = times)
head(resultSwitch)
resultCombined <- combineResults(resultSwitch, resultFC)
head(resultCombined)
plotSSGS(resultCombined, times[-length(times)])
outputGeneTables(resultCombined)
